PP-OCRv5 mobile (text detection / recognition) converted to ONNX.

- det.onnx  = ch_PP-OCRv5_det.onnx  (PP-OCRv5_mobile_det)
- rec.onnx  = ch_PP-OCRv5_rec.onnx  (PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec)
- dict.txt  = ch_PP-OCRv5_dict.txt  (18,383 characters incl. Japanese kana/kanji)

Source of the ONNX files: https://huggingface.co/webnn/PP-OCRv5-ONNX
Original models: PaddleOCR (https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR),
